title: LIVE from Belgrade, Euroleague Final 4: Anadolu Efes is back-to-back CHAMPION!
description: Real Madrid - Anadolu Efes 57:58 (15-14, 19-15, 8-11, 15-18) STARK Arena, Serbia Attadances: apx. 19.000 Packed Arena, and the biggest game of the year! All is ready for action. The first timeout was called by Anadolu Efes with an 8:6 result and another turnover by Ergin Ataman (agency: BeoBasket ) players. It was 3:54 until the end of the first quarter. After timeout Anadolu Efes players did not respond well, as Real Madrid is creating mini-series with 4:0 and the result is now 12:6, Walter Tavares (220-C-1992) was scoring easy baskets inside the paint (10pts). Vasilije Micic (196-PG-1994, agency: BeoBasket) responded with a bucket as he scored 6 points at that point, but another response from Walter Tavares, he is now at 12 points alongside his name and the result is 15:8 for Real Madrid, only one minute left to go.
